newsitems.title: "Dazzling Star" Limited Board
newsitems.author: PWM Game Manager
newsitems.contents: [p]The "Dazzling Star" Limited Board is coming soon! Roll for a chance to get Akane Rin, the featured limited S-class character![/p][p][/p][p]● Available[/p][p]October 21, 2026 (after update) – November 11, 2026, 05:59 (UTC+8)[/p][p][/p][p]● Unlock Requirement[/p][p]Complete the Episode Quest "Prologue: A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"[/p][p][/p][p]● Featuring[/p][p]1. The "Dazzling Star" board features the limited S-class character Akane Rin, along with A-class characters Haniel, Aurelia, and Skia.[/p][p]2. Also on the "Dazzling Star" board: "Day Adrift" glider, "Starbeat Rush" Yesteryear bike livery, and Akane's "Shining Idol" outfit.[/p][p][/p][p]● Board Rules[/p][p]1. The "Dazzling Star" board uses Solid Dice or Void Dice. Roll to move 1–6 tiles (equal chance), land on a tile, and claim the displayed reward.[/p][p]2. All Limited Boards share the same S-class character pity counter, Points Gift progress, and Board Modification progress.[/p][p]3. Skin Perks for the "Dazzling Star" board are time-limited and exclusive to this board. Progress does not carry over to other Limited Boards. Skin Perks for this board include: Daily Outfit, Mod Up! (Livery), and Fashion Center.[/p][p]4. All boards start as Baseline. If the featured S-class character doesn't drop within 70 consecutive rolls, the board upgrades to Modified (rate up). Once you obtain the featured S-class character, the board resets to Baseline.[/p][p]5. If you haven't obtained the featured S-class character after 89 rolls, your 90th roll automatically grants them (your piece will not move). The featured S-class character is guaranteed within 90 rolls.[/p][p]6. Akane Rin is currently only available from the "Dazzling Star" Limited Board, with no other ways to obtain her planned at this time.[/p][p]*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.[/p]
